map_be: excluded by construction; one observation per patient
multiplicity: One primary contrast, reported unadjusted. All other contrasts are secondary within the H1 family and require Holm adjustment before any claim. Fold repetition is not additional independent subjects.

prespecification.comparators: Ridge, Elastic Net and XGBoost as the protocol names, with complexity capped for n=47. No substitution in force.
prespecification.frozen_in_v1_0_0: arm definitions, the primary contrast and its loss, the loss hierarchy and reversal rule, the CV scheme, influence reporting, the prohibited predictor, the MAP-BE exclusion.
prespecification.operationalised_at_analysis_time: log-target fitting with back-transformation, the penalty grids, feature encodings, bootstrap count.

exploratory_success_criterion.threshold: at least 10% relative MAE improvement with a descriptive interval excluding zero

influence.reading: A net gain concentrated in a handful of patients, or present in only one endpoint quartile, is reported as such and caps the status at PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED per protocol section 2.1.

primary_loss.how_to_read: interval_excludes_zero false means no effect was DETECTED, never that there is none. excludes_a_prespecified_size_benefit true means a benefit of at least 10% is incompatible with the interval; false means the design cannot rule one out, which is INCONCLUSIVE rather than NOT_SUPPORTED.

reversal_rule.rule: If the primary loss improves while BOTH robustness co-criteria reverse, the status caps at PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED and the influence analysis becomes mandatory.

log_mae.how_to_read: interval_excludes_zero false means no effect was DETECTED, never that there is none. excludes_a_prespecified_size_benefit true means a benefit of at least 10% is incompatible with the interval; false means the design cannot rule one out, which is INCONCLUSIVE rather than NOT_SUPPORTED.

primary_contrast.why_ridge: Ridge estimates its coefficients from the cohort and cannot borrow strength from literature-fixed constants, so it is the harder test.

target_is: observed pre-dose metoprolol concentration. NOT an AUC, NOT a clearance, NOT a steady-state exposure metric.
